title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant / Finance Administrator

12 Month Fixed-Term Contract

Location: Coventry

Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 DOE

Reed Accountancy are delighted to be supporting a well-established Coventry-based organisation in the recruitment of an Accounts Assistant / Finance Administrator. This is a broad and varied role offering exposure to multiple entities within the group and responsibility for a wide range of transactional finance and administrative duties.

Working as part of a busy finance team, the successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting month-end activities, managing supplier and customer accounts, and helping to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Sales Ledger & Credit Control
- Purchase Ledger.
- Banking & Reconciliations
- Bank Reconciliations.
- Reconcile company credit card statements.
- Investigate and resolve unreconciled items.
- Assist with cash management and reporting activities.
- Analyse expenditure and support cost monitoring activities.
- Assist with management reporting and spreadsheet analysis.
- Maintain supporting schedules and financial records.
- VAT returns.
- Support year-end accounting processes.
- Assist with insurance administration and compliance activities.
- Monitor shared mailboxes and distribute documentation appropriately.

Experience of SAGE would be highly advantageous in addition to EXCEL. You will be a proactive and detail-focused finance professional who enjoys working within a varied role and taking ownership of your workload. Comfortable managing multiple priorities, you will have a strong eye for detail, a methodical approach to problem solving and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider team.

This position offers an excellent opportunity to join a stable and successful organisation where you can make a genuine contribution whilst gaining exposure to a broad range of finance responsibilities.

This role is a FIXED TERM CONTRACT FOR 12 MONTHS - possibility of becoming permanent thereafter.

title: Conveyancing Paralegal
company: Talentwise Solutions Legal Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Residential Conveyancing Paralegal

Location: Coventry, with free onsite parking

Salary: £27,500 to £32,000 commensurate with experience and qualifications

Bonus Scheme: The firm operate a performance-related bonus scheme, with top billers earning up to £3k per month.

About the firm

This is a well-established, independent law firm based in Coventry, with an excellent reputation, consistently good client reviews, a loyal client following and close ties to the local community.

The firm provide a supportive, close-knit working environment where employees have exposure to a broad range of conveyancing work ensuring genuine career progression at your own pace. With a performance-related bonus scheme in place, there is a great scope to earn a high income, significantly increasing your annual salary in recognition of your hard work.

About the Conveyancing Team

There are around 15 people in the conveyancing team, handling a high volume and wide variety of residential property matters. The firm maintain a supportive working environment where members of the team are encouraged to ask questions, learn from more experienced colleagues and develop their own careers, rather than being restricted to one part of the conveyancing process.

What you'll be doing:

Your level of responsibility will be commensurate with your knowledge and experience and will include all or some of the following duties:
- Working closely with experienced members of the conveyancing department, gaining practical exposure to a broad range of residential conveyancing work
- Developing your own conveyancing ability, managing and progressing files under supervision
- Working at your own pace to become increasingly independent
- Liaising directly with clients, estate agents, solicitors, lenders and other parties
- Reviewing title documentation and property searches
- Raising and responding to conveyancing enquiries
- Preparing matters for exchange and completion
- Dealing with freehold and leasehold transactions
- Assisting with transfers of equity, remortgages and other residential property matters
- Preparing correspondence, reports and relevant conveyancing documentation
- Ensuring clients are kept regularly updated throughout their transactions.
- Taking on increasing responsibility as your knowledge and confidence grows, whilst always having appropriate supervision available

Who we're looking for:

Suitable candidates will have:
- A good grounding in residential conveyancing (12 months'+ experience)
- A strong work ethic
- A willingness to learn and develop
- The ability to work well as part of a team
- Excellent communication skills
- A desire to progress your career within residential conveyancing

What's on offer:

The role offers a fabulous opportunity to gain hands on experience, develop your own caseload under supervision with a view to progressing into a more senior fee earning role within the firm over time.

Benefits Include:
- 20 days annual leave plus 8 bank holidays
- Additional paid leave over the Christmas shut down period (between Christmas and New Year) which does not have to be retained from your own entitlement
- Additional paid leave twice per year for Eid Celebrations which does not have to be retained from your own entitlement
- Performance related bonus scheme
- Free on-site parking, subject to availability
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Support for longer-term career progression and professional qualifications (SQE, CILEx and CLC routes are supported)
- A supportive and collaborative working environment

This is a full-time permanent job, working 9:00am to 5:30pm Monday to Friday (37.5 hours per week) The role is fully office-based.

Note: Salary stated is given as a guideline in line with market rate and will be wholly commensurate with experience. The information provided above is correct to the best of our knowledge.

For more information, please contact Tracey at Talentwise Solutions Legal Recruitment

About Talentwise Solutions Legal Recruitment

Talentwise Solutions Legal Recruitment is a family-run, boutique recruitment agency specialising in legal professional and legal support jobs throughout Coventry and Warwickshire, Birmingham and the Midlands.

We offer a tailored service, to find the right role and the right cultural fit for our candidates, and rest assured we will never forward your CV to any firm without first gaining your consent.

About Your Consultant

Tracey is the Owner and Managing Director of Talentwise Solutions Legal Recruitment, where her focus is on offering a prestigious, consultative, open, and honest service - the way she believes recruitment should be!

Tracey's passion for recruitment in the legal sector goes back over thirty years, and today it's stronger than ever. Tracey prides herself on her personalised approach to recruiting and will be on hand to guide you through every stage of the process from initial application through to job offer. You know your career is in great hands with Tracey's experience and expertise.

Know anyone who might be interested? We offer generous bonuses up to £500 for successful referrals. Conditions apply - contact us or view our website for details.

title: Credit Control & Accounts Receivable Administrator
description:
Credit Control & Accounts Receivable Administrator
Location: Coventry HQ / Hybrid
Salary: £26,000 - £28,000 DOE
Contract Type: Permanent, Full Time
Working Hours: 40 hours Monday to Friday, 0900 - 1730 with flex start/ finish
About the role
You'll be part of our Accounts Receivable team, helping customers pay on time, reducing overdue debt and keeping customer accounts accurate.

You'll build relationships with customers and work with Operations to resolve payment queries, disputes and retentions. Alongside collections, you'll handle daily cash posting, payment allocations and customer refunds.

Key responsibilities

Contact customers by phone and email to collect overdue payments and follow up on payment promises.
Post customer receipts daily, allocate payments to the right invoices in Summit, and record any retentions, short payments or allocation queries so they get followed up.
Send payment reminders and follow the agreed debt escalation process.
Log disputes in the AR database and work with customers, contract managers and Operations to resolve them.
Prepare for and attend weekly debt reviews with Operations, providing updates and following up agreed actions.
Track payment plans and support settlement proposals, getting approval in line with company policy.
Process customer refunds accurately, with the required approvals.
Escalate unresolved disputes, missed payment promises and collection risks quickly.
Keep clear records of customer contact, actions and agreements, and handle financial information confidentially.
Support the wider AR team and suggest practical ways we can work better.

What you'll bring

Experience in credit control, accounts receivable or a similar finance role.
Confidence having firm but friendly conversations about overdue payments.
Good organisation and the ability to prioritise a busy workload.
Attention to detail when posting cash, allocating payments and keeping records.
Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to build good working relationships.
Confidence using Excel. Experience of Summit or a similar finance system would be helpful.
A proactive approach, willingness to learn and reliable follow-through.

Why join us?
As the UK's leading grounds maintenance and landscape creation provider, no two projects are ever the same - and neither are our people. That's why we're committed to nurturing a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

What we offer
- We offer career advancement and development opportunities through our bespoke apprenticeship programmes, our extensive in-house training academy, and coaching and mentorship.
- Join a diverse and inclusive workplace where you can collaborate with passionate and talented individuals.
- Contribute to projects that make a real difference in the community and environment.
- We recognise and reward your hard work with our wide-ranging benefits package designed to prioritise your wellbeing, support life choices, and help in both good and challenging times.

Benefits
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
- Enhanced maternity and shared parental leave.
- Support for personal and professional challenges.
- Discounts on retail, holidays, gym memberships, and more.
- Secure your future - competitive pension scheme and resources to manage your finances.
- Colleague of the month and annual awards.
- Two days per year to support a cause of your choice.
- Comprehensive resources and support.

About our client
We are Europe's largest provider of grounds maintenance services and landscape creation, in the UK alone we're a community of over 3,000 passionate colleagues shaping the future of the green industry.

We understand what it means to grow. Our history dates back to 1919, and today, with a turnover of £250 million, we're more than just a company - we're a force for positive change. We offer a range of services to create, maintain, and manage landscapes across the UK.

Grow with us, and together we'll create a greener future for all.

If you receive suspicious outreach claiming to be from us, please contact us via the ManpowerGroup website.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive
- Location: Coventry
- Working: Hybrid
- Salary: Up to £40,000 basic salary + bonus + benefits

About the Role

Our client is looking for a driven and commercially minded B2 B Marketing Executive with experience working with technical products or services. This is an opportunity to play a key role in a digital transformation, taking ownership of marketing activity and directly contributing to lead generation and business growth.

This role offers significant scope for progression. As the company grows, the successful candidate could develop into the number two within the marketing function or take responsibility for leading the function directly.

About You

We're looking for someone who combines strong marketing fundamentals with a genuinely hands-on approach.

You'll ideally have:
- At least 2 years' B2 B marketing experience, preferably working with technical products or services.
- Do you have practical experience across campaign management, content creation, website development and maintenance, and AI-enabled marketing?
- Demonstrable experience using AI in marketing, with examples of tools, systems or workflows you have implemented and the results they delivered.
- Excellent copywriting skills and the ability to understand complex technical propositions and turn them into clear, compelling messaging.
- Strong expertise in at least one of the following areas: copywriting, graphic design or digital marketing, alongside a good understanding of the wider marketing mix.
- A track record of contributing to marketing strategy and delivering measurable campaign results.
- A structured, analytical and data-driven approach to solving complex problems.
- The ability to research markets, interpret information and make well-reasoned recommendations.
- Excellent organisation skills, with the independence and discipline to manage your own workload and deliver against commitments.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to communicate ideas clearly and challenge when necessary.
- A proactive, energetic and entrepreneurial approach, with the ability to thrive within an SME environment.
- A genuine interest in using technology and new tools to improve how marketing is delivered.

Key Responsibilities
- Join a small, hands-on marketing team where the majority of marketing activity is managed and delivered internally.
- Create a broad range of marketing and sales materials, including website content, customer and sales collateral, case studies, news articles, newsletters, product information and release updates.
- Ensure product manuals, FAQs and other technical customer information remain accurate, relevant and up to date.
- Plan and deliver targeted marketing campaigns, including database development, audience segmentation, messaging, campaign automation and performance tracking, with responsibility for generating high-quality leads.
- Manage and develop the company's websites and microsites, including WordPress content, HTML/CSS/JavaScript updates, design improvements, SEO, PPC and emerging AI/LLM search strategies.
- Develop and use AI tools and automated workflows to improve marketing productivity across content creation, design, research, campaigns and reporting.
- Track and evaluate campaign, website and content performance, using insights and data to improve lead generation, conversion and sales support.
- Support social media activity and help shape the company's wider digital presence, with opportunities to take increasing ownership over time.
- Assist with product and marketing strategy by researching target markets, regions, pricing, sales channels and emerging technologies, and helping develop effective product positioning.
- Support larger projects when required, including new product launches, major content initiatives, presentations, webinars, partner marketing, PR, events and industry activities.
- Work closely with the senior leadership team and play an increasingly important role within the marketing function, with the potential to progress into a senior marketing position or lead the function.

title: Part Time Finance Manager
description:
RM Recruit is working with a fantastic organisation based in Coventry who are looking to appoint an experienced and hands-on Finance Manager to join their established team working Part Time, four days per week.

This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional who enjoys being hands-on in the day-to-day running of a finance function, whilst also providing strong management information and financial insight to the wider organisation.

Reporting to the CFO, you will take responsibility for the smooth running of the finance function and will line manage a Finance Officer. This is a varied role, combining management accounts, budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting with the day-to-day operational finance duties that keep the organisation running effectively.

Main duties include:
- Oversee the day-to-day finance function, ensuring transactions, reconciliations and reporting are completed accurately and on time.
- Take ownership of monthly management accounts and month-end processes.
- Prepare financial reports and provide clear financial information to senior stakeholders.
- Manage cash flow, purchase and sales ledgers and general financial operations.
- Work closely with budget holders on budgeting, forecasting and financial performance.
- Support project budgeting and financial planning.
- Provide financial input into business planning and organisational projects.
- Work with colleagues to investigate variances and resolve financial queries.
- Oversee membership and income-related reconciliations, working closely with the CRM system.
- Produce and run reports through the organisation's CRM and finance systems.
- Maintain strong financial controls and ensure processes are continually improved.
- Support statutory accounts, audit preparation and wider compliance requirements.

As the ideal canddiate,you will be a qualified or part-qualified accountant, or someone who has developed strong finance experience through relevant practical experience. Most importantly, you will have a solid understanding of management accounts, financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, alongside the confidence to take ownership of the day-to-day finance function.

You will ideally possess strong experience across management and financial accounts coupled with budgeting, forecasting and business partnering. You will be a competent user in excel and possess strong communication skills and the confidence to work with non-finance colleagues. Experience within the charity/not-for-profit sector would be advantageous, but is not essential.

This role benefits from hybrid working with office presence required twice per week including flexible working hours and a supportive and friendly working environment.

RM Recruit is committed to Equality, Diversity and Inclusion and will treat all applicants equally irrespective of sex, sexual orientation, marital/civil partnership status, age, disability, race, religion, pregnancy, ethnic or national origin
